test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 10 Dec, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
In the following passage, some words have been deleted. Read the passage carefully and select the most appropriate option to fill in each blank.

Mount Vesuvius is (1) _______ near Pompeii. It began to erupt and covered everything with stones and hot ash which fell like (2) _______ from the sky. It (3) ______ the city almost under 2 metres of volcanic molten material.
solution:
The correct answer is '**located**', '**a blizzard**', and '**buried**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The verb "**located**" is the appropriate form to describe the position of Mount Vesuvius near Pompeii.
 
• The noun "**a blizzard**" aptly describes the way stones and hot ash fell from the sky, creating a chaotic scene similar to a snowstorm.
 
• The verb "**buried**" correctly describes how the city was covered under volcanic material.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Complete Passage:** *"Mount Vesuvius is **located**__ near Pompeii. It began to erupt and covered everything with stones and hot ash which fell like __**a blizzard**__ from the sky. It __**buried**__ the city almost under 2 metres of volcanic molten material."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: **"situated" is a possible synonym for "located", but "tornado" and "treasured" do not fit contextually.
 
• **Option 3:** "found" is less specific than "located", and "hail" doesn't capture the intensity of the falling debris; "ignored" is incorrect.
 
• **Option 4: **"placed" is less specific than "located", "volcano" is redundant, and "hid" is incorrect.
